issues.detail: Hebrew 'וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף' means 'consumed by plague/burning' (literally 'eaten by Resheph'), but Vietnamese renders 'bị thiêu đốt bởi cơn giận dữ' ('burned by wrath/anger'), introducing 'cơn giận dữ' (wrath) which is not in the Hebrew; 'רֶשֶׁף' is a noun meaning 'flame/plague' (often a deity of plague), not 'anger'.
